metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Hong Kong increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels over Hong Kong between two specific time periods in 2020. This requires: 1. Data: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data which provides NO₂ measurements 2. Collection: 'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2' for Level 3 NO₂ data 3. Band: 'NO2_column_number_density' for tropospheric NO₂ 4. Location: Hong Kong (need to define a polygon geometry) 5. Time periods: - Period 1: 2020-02-10 to 2020-02-25 - Period 2: 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-12 Strategy: - Get NO₂ collections for both periods - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Calculate mean NO₂ for each period over Hong Kong - Check for valid pixels (C2) - Validate results (C3) - Compare means to answer the question For cloud masking: NO₂ data from Sentinel-5P doesn't need cloud masking in the same way as optical data, but we should check for valid data using quality flags if available. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var hongKong = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[113.8, 22.15], [114.4, 22.15], [114.4, 22.55], [113.8, 22.55], [113.8, 22.15]] ]); var period1_start = '2020-02-10'; var period1_end = '2020-02-25'; var period2_start = '2020-04-20'; var period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // 2. Data Acquisition var no2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(hongKong); var no2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(hongKong); // Check collection sizes var size1 = no2_col1.size().getInfo(); var size2 = no2_col2.size().getInfo(); print('Period 1 (Feb 10-25) Images: ' + size1); print('Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12) Images: ' + size2); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NO2 for each period var mean_no2_1 = no2_col1.mean().select('NO2_column_number_density'); var mean_no2_2 = no2_col2.mean().select('NO2_column_number_density'); // Check pixel counts var count1 = mean_no2_1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var count2 = mean_no2_2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); print('Period 1 Valid Pixels: ' + count1); print('Period 2 Valid Pixels: ' + count2); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NO2 values var val1 = mean_no2_1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); var val2 = mean_no2_2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: hongKong, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer print('Feb 10-25 Mean NO2: ' + val1.toFixed(6)); print('Apr 20-May 12 Mean NO2: ' + val2.toFixed(6)); // Check for invalid values if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2) || val1 < 0 || val2 < 0) { print('C3'); } else if (val2 > val1) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
